--the city of यक्षस् in कैलास. Capital of Kubera.
1: Br. II. १८. 2; III. 7. १६३; वा. ४७. 1; भा. IV. 6. २३.
पुरूरवस् and उर्वशी sported here for a time;
2: वा. ९१. 6; Br. III. ६६. 6; Vi. IV. 6. ४८.
as seen by भार्गव Ra1ma.
3: Br. III. ४१. १८-23.
[page१-115+ २६]

--The R. in कैलास: a branch of गङ्गा issuing out of the city of ब्रह्मा descends the southern slopes of Meru. Her course can be traced from the Gan- धमादन. Traversing the हेमकूट and Himalayas as also the continent of Bharata and dividing itself into seven branches it enters the sea on the south. A bath in this stream is equal to performing अश्वमेधस् and other sacri- fices. A महानदी: borne by शिव on his head for more than a hundred years: Elevated Sagara's sons to heaven. भा. IV. 6. २४; V. १७. 5 and 9; IX. २९. ४२; Br. III. ४१. २१; ५६. १२; Vi. II. 2. ३४, ३६; 8. ११३-20; वा. ४१. १८. ४२. २५-35; १०८. ८०.
--a daughter of इरा, and mother of trees. Br. III. 7. ४६०-1.

--depend on वर्ण, स्थानयोग and नाट्य: Three places of origin--neck, head and mind: 4 वर्णस्, eight विकल्पस्, and sixteen deities: Different kinds of, described:
1: Br. III. ६२. 2-२३.
३०० varieties distinguished.
2: वा. ८७. 1-3, १०-21.
--a mindborn mother. M. १७९. २२.
--an Apsaras. Br. III. 7. 6; IV. ३३. १८; वा. ६९. 5.
(I)--a pupil of दत्तात्रेय: a sage who realised the force of हरिमाया। भा. I. 3. ११; II. 7. ४४.

(II)--a son of Dyumat, and father of Sannati. He retained his youth and ruled for ६६,000 years. The ब्र्। पुराण and the विष्णु पुराण make him the son respectively [page१-116+ २८] of Vatsa and Pratardana, and father of Sannati.
1: Br. III. ६७. ६९, ७२; Vi. IV. 8. १६-18; भा. IX. १७. 6-8.
A राजऋषि of काशी; attained longevity through the grace of लोपामुद्रा. Killed the राक्षस Ks2emaka and recovered his capital. Two ancient verses in his praise.
2: M. १८०. ६८-9; वा. ९२. ६६-8.
--a deity. Br. IV. २७. ३८.
--gourds unfit for श्राद्ध। Vi. III. १६. 8.
--the gourd-vessel of the नागस् to milk the earth cow. Br. II. ३६. २१३; M. १०. १९.
--a class of sages. M. २००. १७. [page१-175+ २९]
--see योग। Vi. VI. 7. ४२.
--a daughter of खशा, and a राक्षसी, after whom came the आलम्बेय गण। Br. III. 7. १३८; वा. ६९. १७०.
--a श्रुतऋषि: the chief author of the यजुर्वेद of the Eastern recension. Br. II. ३३. 6.
--of the प्राच्यस्; also त्रयोदश्यादयः। वा. ६१. 9.
--a राक्षस clan after आलम्बा। Br. III. 7. १४०.
--a cruel राक्षस गण from आलम्बा. वा. ६९. १७२.

--temple for इश्वर.--(see आयतनम्);
1: वा. ३०. २७९; ९१. २९; १०१. २१४.
or a place of residence.
